movie.title: Back to the 90s
movie.overview: When a mysterious glitch sends a rising boyband back to 1995 - just days before the biggest showcase of their lives - the five friends race to reverse the time slip. But as unexpected connections form and the past pulls them in deeper, getting home means confronting what they're willing to leave behind - and who they truly are to each other.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a friction-filled boy band's big break is threatened by a member's sudden departure, five lifelong friends are unexpectedly transported back in time to the 1990s.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Five best friends who have dreamed of boy band stardom since childhood finally get the chance to make their big break. However, tension erupts when one member decides to throw in the towel, putting the entire group's future on the line. As they fight to keep their dreams alive, a bizarre twist of fate hurls the five guys back into the 1990s. Now, they must navigate the iconic decade to fix their bond and find a way back home.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Bound by a shared childhood dream, five close friends have spent years working toward becoming the next big boy band. Their tireless efforts finally pay off when a high-stakes, once-in-a-lifetime opportunity presents itself, promising to launch them into stardom. Just as their moment arrives, internal conflict strikes when one member abruptly decides to give up on music entirely. Refusing to let their shared goal vanish, the remaining members press on, forcing the entire group to confront their personal differences. During the ensuing confrontation and chaos, a mysterious occurrence suddenly rips the five friends from the present day and drops them directly into the 1990s. Stuck in a completely different decade, the group must adapt to the retro era's unique culture and challenges without modern conveniences. As they navigate this unfamiliar past, the friends are forced to re-examine their individual motivations, loyalties, and shared passions. The journey tests the limits of their brotherhood, revealing that surviving the 90s requires more than just musical talent. Ultimately, they must learn to truly unite as a band if they hope to repair their friendships, realize their dreams, and return to their original time.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Since childhood, five best friends have shared an unwavering dream of taking the music world by storm as a boy band. After years of practice, sacrifice, and endless optimism, they finally land a once-in-a-lifetime break that could transform their lives forever. However, on the cusp of success, internal friction reaches a breaking point when one member suddenly decides to abandon the group, jeopardizing their entire future. As the friends attempt to pull together and overcome the crisis, an unexpected turn of events transports all five of them back to the 1990s. Stranded in a colorful yet challenging decade, the group must learn to navigate an era defined by different culture, tech, and music while confronting the personal issues tearing them apart. To find a way home and realize their musical ambitions, they must rediscover the bond that brought them together in the first place.

story_structure.risingAction: As the friends try to unite and rise to the occasion to save their band's big break, a sudden shift unexpectedly sends them into a completely different decade.
